description: Stadt Zehdenick - Straßenbeleuchtung is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. The data represent the street lamps of the city of Zehdenick as well as the surrounding districts. The point geometries have the attributes: District, street (location), street name and number of the next building and lamp number. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "City of Zehdenick - Street lighting" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include opendata. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
